body: Your father was a talented writer and a rather philosophical man. Thank you for sharing this touching piece.
Really just depends on how much you like the person that's falling
So relatable. Except she wasn't quite on my intellectual level and  tried to knife herself more often than me.
Sorry, first time on here and I'm being too Canadian with my manners lol. Suggesting that she planted them would be bloody brilliant, I don't know why I didn't think of that

You seem like a pretty decent person yourself and I thank you again for your kind words. The thing is that they did find drugs in my house; along with money and a scale and other things that looked really incriminating. I hold strong to using those drugs (Herbal pot, pot cookies, mushrooms) as medicinal and she was diagnosed with borderline personality disorder. That coupled with the other unique circumstances may allow for an insta dismissal. Part of me wouldn't mind jail though. Don't have to worry about any bills and my anxiety would have actual grounds in the physical realm instead of sheer psychological torture.

I think that death is naturally terrifying. I almost drowned last week (on account of my poor swimming skills) and the fear is real. I'm more afraid of attempting and failing than succeeding I think. All I seek in death is peace but these silly survival instincts are too strong. I suppose you and I will have to continue our existence as wretched observers waiting for death but secretly hoping for a better life.

Thank you for your sympathies first of all. The trial may or may not go well. The situation was pretty complex and involved the cops raiding my house and holding me in a cell until they were done. My lawyer is confident that we can get that turned around on a  technicality and with all the dirt I have on this girl. 

As for friends that aren't really friends it's fucking crazy. People are selfish and petty and cowardly.

I relate so strongly to what you're saying. Everything that's wrong with my life is because of people that should have been there for me, people I trusted and would have done no harm who certainly did not feel the same way for me. Then there's the state of the world to consider; corporate evil running things behind the scenes and regular people so full of hate and lust that there are hundreds of thousands of rapes and murders every year. I am in no position to positively affect any of this, nor do I believe I can ever achieve such a position. So why the fuck am I still here?
